blurb: a phrasebook of stock phrases you quote-and-repost verbatim to link otherwise-unrelated posts — seeded with @tk0l.bsky.social's original thread. sign in to keep your own phrases as net.bisks.memex.phrase records on your PDS, and see "what's atomic": a network-wide leaderboard of which phrases the most people have adopted. built for @antiali.as, who asked to have "you rubes, you fucking marks" added to the canon.
